title: America's Book of Secrets: Special
description:
S01 E03 — Top Secret Operations
Uncovering the clandestine activities and state-of-the-art training of the U.S. Army Special Forces and government agencies that undertake the most dangerous surveillance, reconnaissance, and intelligence collecting missions on Earth.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S01 E02 — The White House
Protocols, security, and hidden history of the free world's most public private residence.

title: Ancient Empires
description:
S01 E01 — Alexander the Great
The greatest conqueror and general in history, Alexander the Great of Macedon built one of the largest empires ever seen in just 13 years.

title: Ancient Empires
description:
S01 E02 — Caesar
Overcoming overwhelming odds fighting throughout the Mediterranean, Caesar's decisive actions bring him massive success and make him the most powerful man in the world; every gambler knows that luck runs out eventually.

title: Ancient Empires
description:
S01 E03 — Cleopatra
The enigmatic Egyptian Queen Cleopatra's untold true story is one of a ruthless genius, doing anything necessary to cling onto power in the face of an aggressively expanding Roman Empire.

title: WWII in HD
description:
S01 E01 — Darkness Falls; Hard Way Back
As Europe falls under the sway of Nazi Germany, America is unprepared for war and the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor; the Allies take on Axis forces in North Africa and the Pacific. Narrator: Gary Sinise.

title: WWII in HD
description:
S01 E02 — Hard Way Back
Charles Scheffel battles German forces in North Africa; Jack Werner faces bitter combat against the Japanese in the Pacific.

title: WWII in HD
description:
S01 E03 — Bloody Resolve
U.S. Marines assault Japanese-held Tarawa in the Pacific; the fighting in Italy claims a casualty. Narrator: Gary Sinise.

title: WWII in HD
description:
S01 E04 — Battle Stations
The Allies lay plans for the invasion of France; Bert Stiles and the 8th Air Force try to win air supremacy over Normandy as D-Day arrives.

title: WWII in HD
description:
S01 E05 — Day of Days
The Allies get bogged down in Normandy's hedgerows after D-Day; victory turns to horror on Saipan in the Pacific.

title: WWII in HD
description:
S01 E06 — Point of No Return
U.S. Marines battle for Peleliu in the Pacific; the Allies race toward Germany. Narrator: Gary Sinise.

title: Mail Call
description:
S01 E08 — Revolutionary War Musket; Jousting; Foxholes
How fast a Revolutionary War soldier could fire a musket; jousting; how to dig a foxhole.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S02 E10 — Tabar
Four bladesmiths take an ordinary garden lawnmower and use its metal to create one of their signature blades; two will make it to the final round during which they must forge a Tabar, a battle-ax from Southern Asia.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E05 — Crusader Sword
Following a difficult first round of testing, the remaining two bladesmiths head home with only five days to forge the legendary Crusader Sword.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S02 E05 — Viking Sword
In a race against time, four bladesmiths have to salvage material from a car and forge a blade; two will make it to the final round where they will have just five days to create a Viking sword.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E06 — The Elizabethan Rapier
The bladesmiths have to use an age-old technique to make their signature weapons; two finalists head to their home forges to create one of history's most notorious weapons, the rapier.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S02 E03 — The Scottish Claymore
Four blade smiths face grueling challenges when the electricity and power tools are taken away from them; only two will survive and move on to the final round where they'll have just five days to create the iconic Scottish Claymore.

title: Forged in Fire: Beat the Judges
description:
S01 E01 — Short Sword Damascus
Three champions return to the forge, hoping to defeat one of the three judges; after forging signature blades and a Khanda, one champion survives to enter their toughest challenge yet, competing against a judge.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S01 E04 — Katar
Competitors make their signature blade by using the Hada technique, a traditional process that involves forging multiple layers of steel together.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E04 — Compound Fracture
The contestants' archery skills are put to the test with a modern compound bow; tubular team challenge; tensions with team leadership threaten to unravel the group.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E05 — Quickfire Face-Off
Head-to-head speed-shooting showdown; the contestants get surprise visitors to help train.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E06 — Bury the Hatchet
Marksmen compete with the tomahawk and blowgun; one of the most intense challenges of the season shows who has natural skills and adaptability and who doesn't.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E07 — Trick Shot Showdown II
Contestants split a bullet on an axe; iconic shots from exhibition shooting history.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E08 — Catch .22
Competitors face an extreme shooting gallery; the marksmen face off with a 22-caliber which levels the playing field.

title: Top Shot
description:
The 1000 Yard Shot
Marksmen face a supreme long-range test, the iconic 1,000-yard shot; a Barrett 82A1.50.

description:
S02 E10 — The Shakedown
